newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dongfang says joint-ventures approved.
newsitem.headline: Dongfang says joint-ventures approved.

text.p: Dongfang Electrical Machinery Co Ltd said on Tuesday its joint-venture projects have been approved by China's State Planning Commisssion.
Dongfang has a joint venture project with General Electric Canada Inc, and Voest-Apline Technologie AG and Elin of Austria to produce hydro turbine generator sets in China.
It also co-operated with Siemens Aktien Gesellschaft to produce thermal power generators.
"Preparatory work and contract finalisation for these projects are still underway. Therefore the company has not yet injected funds in to the joint-venture projects," it said.
The joint venture projects, which are worth around 400 million yuan, have been postponed under China's austerity policy since 1994. -- HONG KONG NEWSROOM (852) 2843 6369
